notes:
Updates since 1.0.1:

• Removed the directors line from the HTML report footer.
• Fixed bladder and lens maximum-dose checks incorrectly showing Not evaluable.
• Added locally saved clinical goals under Settings, supplementing the built-in defaults.
• Added a searchable OAR dropdown using structures common to the selected DVH files.
• Simplified goal entry: click +, select an OAR and type an objective such as V30Gy<30%.
• Added objective validation and support for <, <=, > and >= comparisons.
• Fixed text-field focus and typing issues.
• Reformatted HTML checks into compact clinical-goal tables grouped by structure.
• Removed the Status column; results use green for met, red for not met and grey for not evaluable, with a colour legend.
• Fixed summary counts and failure colours.

Built-in default constraints and NTCP calculation models remain unchanged. Recalculate reports to apply the updates.
